command.name: security key-manager external barbican create-config
command.description: This command creates a Barbican configuration which can be enabled on a Vserver.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: Each configuration must have a configuration name which is unique within a Vserver.

parameter.name: application-cred-id
parameter.description: The ID of the Keystone application credentials.

parameter.name: keystone-url
parameter.description: The HTTPS URL of the Keystone authorization service.

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: The HTTPS URL of the Barbican secret.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: Use this parameter to verify the authenticity of the the Barbican Host. The verify value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to verify the hostname of the Barbican configuration. The verify-host value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy type. The proxy-type value must be HTTP or HTTPS.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy host.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy port.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy username.

parameter.name: proxy-password
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy password.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the timeout, in seconds, for attempting to connect to the Barbican service.

parameter.name: polling-period
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the health monitor polling period of the Barbican configuration in seconds.

example.p: The example below creates a configuration on a node with the following details: For Vserver vsTest, configuration name: config1, Key ID: https://sample.com:5000/v3, Keystone URL: https://sample.keystone.com:5000/v3, Application Credentials ID: app_cred_id.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external barbican create-config -vserver vsTest -config-name config1 -key-id https://sample.com:5000/v3 -keystone-url https://sample.keystone.com:5000/v3 -application-cred-id app_cred_id
